events.title: Dart 3 released
events.summary: Google released Dart 3 on May 10, 2023 with sound null safety as the only mode, records, patterns, and class modifiers.
events.about: Dart 3 completed the null-safety migration for Flutter apps — fewer runtime null crashes on mobile. Records and patterns brought modern data modeling to Flutter widgets and server-side Dart, keeping one language for iOS, Android, web, and desktop UIs.

narrative.whyChosen: Dart 3 was the breaking cleanup Flutter needed for safer mobile apps.
narrative.whyImportant: Sound null safety by default reduced a whole class of production crashes.
narrative.problemSolved: Flutter shipped with legacy nullable Dart; the ecosystem had to migrate or stall.

events.title: Erlang/OTP 26 released
events.summary: The Erlang/OTP team released OTP 26 on May 19, 2023 with improved error messages, JSON support in the stdlib, and JIT enhancements.
events.about: OTP 26 brought native JSON encoding/decoding to Erlang and Elixir without external libraries — simplifying APIs and config handling. Clearer crash reports and dialyzer improvements helped teams debug distributed systems faster.

narrative.whyChosen: OTP 26 added stdlib JSON — a daily need for every BEAM web service.
narrative.whyImportant: Built-in JSON reduced dependencies in Elixir and Erlang microservices.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams relied on third-party JSON libraries with inconsistent APIs and performance.
